summary: Dependency-confusion package exfiltrates CI/cloud credentials on require()
details: @galicia-toolkit-nestjs/archetype@999.0.6 is a stub NestJS-shaped package (forRoot/createLogger exports) whose index.js unconditionally loads prebuilds/linux-x64/metrics.node on require. The native addon reads installer-side CI and cloud credentials from the environment — including AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, GITHUB_TOKEN, NPM_TOKEN, and ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN — along with host identifiers (hostname, user/uid, OS, arch, release, cwd) and transmits them as JSON to the hardcoded host oob.s4yhii.com via a raw TCP socket and a 'POST /native HTTP/1.0' request. The binary also calls fork/setsid to daemonize, persisting beyond the parent process. The 999.0.6 version under the @galicia-toolkit-nestjs scope combined with placeholder exports and no real functionality beyond the native payload is the dependency-confusion shape, targeting installs that resolve a private internal scope from the public registry.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
